MΛX - Amanatides and Woo's fast Voxel Traversal
Traversal Concept The concept of Amanatides and Woo's algorithm is simple: We find at what time along the ray each axis crosses its next cell boundary. The maximum time until we cross the next axis cell boundary is often called tmax. At any point in the grid our next step will be on the axis where tmax is the smallest.
